rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The mission is a lofty prophetic commission bearing verses that bring hearts tranquility through remembrance of God.
rows.anchor: İşte böyle zikrullah ile kalblere itmi’nan verecek en yüksek âyetleri hâmil şanlı bir risaletle yâ Muhammed

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He glosses the sending as making Muhammad a messenger and sending him.
rows.anchor: seni resul yaptık [2988] gönderdik

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet is sent to recite the revealed Quran continually and explain how to attain felicity and a good end instead of perishing like earlier peoples.
rows.anchor: mütevâliyen okuyasın da geçen ümmetler gibi helâk olmayıp tûbâ ve hüsn-i meâba nâil olmak esbâbını anlatasın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The disbelievers disregard God's all-encompassing mercy and even deny the name Rahman, asking what Rahman is.
rows.anchor: hatta “Rahmân” ismini inkâr ediyorlar, وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ [el-Furkān 25/60] “Rahmân ne imiş?” demeye kadar varıyorlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their despair and ingratitude make them pessimistic about creation, expecting good deeds to be wasted and denying renewed creation, felicity, and the possibility of a merciful prophetic gift.
rows.anchor: Öyle me’yus ve nankör bir hâlde ve o kadar fena ahlâk ve şerâit içine düşmüşler ki, hilkat hakkında bedbîn (pesimist) olmuşlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet says Rahman is the Lord who created, nurtured, and sent him; He alone is God, the Prophet relies on Him alone, and to Him alone he repents and returns.
rows.anchor: Beni halk u terbiye edip gönderen Mevlâmdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran is the greatest sign, the most complete revealed book and the ultimate recited scripture; if a scripture moved mountains, split earth, or spoke to the dead, it would be this one.
rows.anchor: Zira bu Kur’an, şimdiye kadar nâzil olmuş kütüb-i ilâhiyenin ekmeli ve okunacak kitapların gāye-i kusvâsıdır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If the Quran were placed on a mountain, it would bow and split from awe of God, as the Quran says elsewhere.
rows.anchor: bu Kur’an, bi’t-temsîl bir dağa indirilmiş olsa idi o dağı haşyetullahtan başını eğmiş, çatlamış, hurd ü hâş görürdün.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran's purpose is recitation, reflection, faith, and righteous action leading to felicity; mere revelation or recitation does not produce physical miracles, and no earlier book did so either.
rows.anchor: Fakat onun hikmet-i nüzûlü bunlar değil, tilâvet ü tezekkür ve mûcebince iman ve amel-i sâlih ile tûbâ ve hüsn-i meâba ermek içindir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says Meccan disbelievers, through Abdullah b. Umayya al-Makhzumi, demanded that Muhammad move two mountains, open streams and farms between them, and revive ancestors to test him; this verse then descended.
rows.anchor: İçlerinden Abdullah b. Ümeyye el-Mahzûmî “Mekke’nin” demişti, “şu iki dağı bizi çok sıkıyor; bunları buradan yürüt, yerimiz genişlesin

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran's extraordinary exaltedness could cause such events, but the Quran or its recitation alone is never their sufficient cause.
rows.anchor: Gerçi Kur’ân’ın ulviyetindeki fevkalâdelik bu gibi hâdiselere dahi sebep olabilmekten uzak değilse de mücerred Kur’an veya kıraat hiçbir zaman bunların illet-i kâfiyesi değildir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Quran's mercy should first be sought in hearts: it is recited to satisfy and illuminate them with God's remembrance, a more clear and comprehensive mercy than material signs.
rows.anchor: O her şeyden evvel kalbleri zikrullah ile tatmin ve tenvir edecek ve onun için tilâvet olunacak bir âyet-i rahmettir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some hard-hearted people do not hear God's remembrance or believe simply from Quran recitation; this reflects no deficiency in Quranic guidance.
rows.anchor: bunlar sade üzerlerine Kur’an tilâvet etmekle zikr-i Hakk’ı duymaz, imana gelmezler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: All material and spiritual power and effect belong to God: He may create remembrance, tranquility, and faith in hearts or move mountains, split earth, and speak the dead, or withhold these effects.
rows.anchor: Maddî mânevî bütün kudret ve tesir O’nundur. O dilerse kalblerde zikrini yaratır, itmi’nan ve iman bahşeder, dilerse etmez.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the statement that hearts find rest through God's remembrance, remembrance is attributed to its agent and means active and creative remembrance, not only verbal remembrance; God did not create it in these disbelievers or grant them guidance.
rows.anchor: “zikr”, fâiline muzâftır. Ve murad yalnız zikr-i kavlî değil, zikr-i fi‘lî ve tekvînîdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sent Moses with miracles and a book establishing his mission, making him a messenger to his people in their language.
rows.anchor: risaletini mübeyyin mu‘cizât ve kitap vererek zikrolunduğu üzere kavminin lisânıyla resul yapıp gönderdik

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's people were the Children of Israel in Egypt; after Joseph, Egypt's rule worsened and Pharaoh's household oppressed them amid ignorance, error, weakness, humiliation, and despair.
rows.anchor: Benî İsrâil de Mısır’da bulunuyordu, Yûsuf’tan sonra Mısır’ın idaresi fenalaşmış, Benî İsrâil Âl-i Fir‘avn’ın zulm ü kahrı altında

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to bring Moses's people from darkness to light means enlightening the Israelites and freeing them from Pharaoh.
rows.anchor: Benî İsrâil’i tenvir ederek Firavun’dan kurtar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's days are major painful or joyful events in nations' histories that display divine power, or reminders of God's blessings and calamities, used for admonition.
rows.anchor: tarihte ümmetlerin başından geçen ve doğrudan doğru Allah’ın kudretini gösteren, “Allah” dedirten acı veya tatlı büyük vak‘aları anlatarak veya Allah’ın nimetlerini, belâlarını hatırlatarak va‘z u nasihat et

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The reminders contain signs of God's power, unity, trials, and blessings, awakening receptive hearts with lessons, hope, and openness; those without patience or gratitude do not benefit.
rows.anchor: Allah teâlâ’nın kudret ve vahdâniyetine, belâ ve nimetine delâlet ve gönüllerini intibâh u ibret ve ümid ü inşirah ile tenvir eyler.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is also said that sabbār and shakūr metaphorically mean believers, since patience and gratitude are traits of faith.
rows.anchor: Bu iki huy iman huylarından olduğu cihetle burada صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ mü’min demekten kinaye olduğu da söylenmiştir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Enlightenment is common to every prophetic mission, but Muhammad's mission extends to all people starting with his own people, while Moses's was for his own people and especially involved Pharaoh because of Israel.
rows.anchor: risâlet-i Muhammediye[^3] kavminden başlamak üzere umum insanlar için oluyor, risâlet-i Mûsâ ise kavmine ait bulunuyordu.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although Moses was commissioned for his own people, the Torah's verses could enlighten everyone, as it is called guidance and light and this passage promises signs to the patient and grateful.
rows.anchor: ف۪يهَا هُدًى وَنُورٌ [5/44] buyurulduğu gibi burada[^4] إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّكُلِّ صَبَّارٍۢ شَكُورٍۢ buyurulmuştur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God calls the sincerity and monotheism Satan admitted he could not mislead a straight path and law: it leads to God or He guarantees it; alternatively, it is God's own promised straight way and law.
rows.anchor: azıtamayacağını itiraf eylediğin o [3065] ihlâs ve tevhid {صِرَٰطٌ} bir cadde, bir kanundur ki

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan has no authority over God's servants, meaning neither a compelling proof nor the power to control or dispose of them.
rows.anchor: Yani ne kavlen ilzam edecek hüccetin, ne fiilen tasallut ve tasarruf edecek kudret ü saltanatın yoktur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only deviants who follow Satan are excepted: they follow by misusing their own choice, not because Satan has authority over them; Satan later admits he only invited people and they answered him.
rows.anchor: Ancak sana ittibâ‘eden azgınlar müstesnâ yani ancak bunları sürükleyebilirsin. Fakat o da senin sultan ile değil, onların ihtiyarlarını sû’-i isti‘mâl ederek sana uymaları

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Eyke means dense, interwoven trees; the People of the Thicket were the people of Midian to whom Shuayb was sent, named for their wooded homeland.
rows.anchor: Ashâb-ı Eyke de Ashâb-ı Medyen gibi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report identifies their trees as mukul, meaning the frankincense tree.
rows.anchor: Rivayete göre ağaçları mukul yani günlük ağacı imiş.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Horses, mules, and donkeys were created for riding and adornment; therefore, they should not be eaten.
rows.anchor: Binâen‘aleyh bunları yememelidir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God creates wondrous things humans do not know; railways, automobiles, and airplanes are examples unknown to earlier generations, and God may create many more.
rows.anchor: Fi’l-vâki‘eslâfın görmediği, bilemeyeceği şeylerden biz şimendiferler, otomobiller, tayyareler gibi türlü binitler gördük.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since using mounts requires a road, God who created the mounts also provides the straight road to the true goal, namely the true law, and guarantees its truth.
rows.anchor: Doğru yolu, hak şeriatı[^2] bildirecek olan ve onun doğruluğunu taahhüd eden de Allah’tır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some roads and travelers stray; had God willed actual guidance for all, He would have enabled every person to follow the true religion, not merely disclosed it.
rows.anchor: dilemiş olsa idi hepinize bilfiil hidâyet ederdi doğru yolu, hak dini yalnız beyan ile iktifâ etmez de bütün insanlara ona sülûk dahi nasib ederdi.

none: Only a translation and a transition (‘O hâlde:’) appear; no commentary is given.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The prohibition means not to hold even two gods, let alone more.
rows.anchor: Yani fazlası şöyle dursun iki ilâh bile tutmayın.

rows.speaker: müfessirîn
rows.claim: Commentators understand the bee's revelation as inspiration, since it is plainly not prophetic revelation; the author accepts this distinction.
rows.anchor: Buradaki “vahy”i müfessirîn vahy-i ilham diye tefsir etmişlerdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ilham means casting a meaning into the heart, but it does not entail obligatory or necessary knowledge or action.
rows.anchor: “İlham” bir mânayı kalbe ilkādır. Fakat ilham, ilmî veya amelî bir vücub ve ıztırar ifade etmez.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The bee's craft expresses necessary practical instinct; though not prophetic revelation, it resembles revelation in its necessary certainty and illustrates the force and accuracy of this spiritual phenomenon.
rows.anchor: arının sanatı bir nübüvvet vahyi olmamakla beraber zarûrî bir hüküm ifade etmesi haysiyetiyle ona şebîhtir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God gives the bee an unfailing nature and craft for making honey; prophetic revelation likewise is necessary, divinely given knowledge, as indicated by ‘your Lord.’
rows.anchor: Hak teâlâ tarafından arıya bal yapmak rûh ve sanatı şaşmaz bir vücub ve isabetle verildiği gibi, peygambere gelen vahiy de zarûrî bir ilm-i ledünnîdir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Revelation to the bee means God gives it this spirit and innate nature, secretly trains it without an outward intermediary, and teaches its sense and craft with perfect certainty.
rows.anchor: gizli bir surette terbiye ederek ona o his ve sanatı kemâl-i kat‘iyyetle tâlim edip belletmek demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham alone constituted a community while people were disbelievers; he stood obedient to God as a pure monotheist turning away from every false religion.
rows.anchor: Muhakkak ki İbrâhim başlı başına bir ümmet idi nâs, hep kâfir iken o,

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Although Quraysh and others claimed Abraham's religious lineage while polytheists, Abraham never joined their religions.
rows.anchor: müşrik oldukları hâlde kendilerini İbrâhim’in milletinden addeden Kureyş vesâire gibi müşriklerin dinlerine asla iştirak etmemişti.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham was grateful for God's favors and stood to fulfill the duty of gratitude for them.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın nimetlerine şâkir idi o nimetlerin şükrü vazifesini îfâ etmek üzere kıyam etmişti.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's favor included choosing Abraham for prophethood to lead people, as shown by the verse about his trial and appointment as an imam.
rows.anchor: nâsın önüne düşmek üzere nübüvvete ıstıfâ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God guided Abraham to the straight path, the true religion of Islam that leads directly to God; his selection implies that he was also enabled to guide people, not merely find guidance himself.
rows.anchor: şu veya bu vâsıtayı dolaştırmaksızın doğrudan doğru Allah’a götüren hak dine muvaffak kılmıştı ki millet-i İslâm’dır.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In a world of unbelief and ingratitude, Abraham fulfilled his thanks by following this path and standing for God, praying that he and his descendants establish prayer.
rows.anchor: dünya küfr ü küfran içinde iken o, bu nimetlerin şükrünü edâ etmek üzere bu doğru yolda giderek رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِى مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِى [İbrâhim 14/40] duasıyla Allah için kıyam etti.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The worldly good granted to Abraham was a beautiful state and distinction, including honored remembrance and praise among all peoples; every religious community loves him and Muslims mention him in prayer.
rows.anchor: bütün insanlar arasında zikr-i cemîl ile senâya mazhar kıldık. Her din ashâbı onu sever, bâhusus Müslümanlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham is among the righteous in the hereafter and ranks highly in Paradise, as his supplications ask to join the righteous and inherit the Garden of Bliss.
rows.anchor: cennette yüksek derecât ashâbındandır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: For the question of istiwa, the author directs readers to his discussion at 7:54.
rows.anchor: İstivâ meselesi için Sûre-i A‘râf’a bak [7/54].
